verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents official TypeScript/JavaScript and Python SDKs with install-and-use guides covering scraping and brand data, and states that the context.dev-named packages are the supported ones going forward. A published OpenAPI spec backs the API surface the SDKs wrap. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs specifically, evidence of SDKs beyond TypeScript and Python, and evidence of SDK depth (full API coverage, typed models, versioning).
